name: Harlequinade
storyline:
A never-ending carnival and a death-prone college student...

Tired from your studies, your friends drag you out for a night of fun out at a traveling carnival. But for some reason, you can't help but feel the sense of déjà vu...

Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a day that keeps going on forever—unless you find out how to stop it for good with the help of the clowns stuck at the carnival with you.
summary: Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a very death-prone college student. With the aid of 2 clowns, can you escape this timeloop?
